description: This file defines a class 'CodeGuruProfilerClient' in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically to interact with the Amazon CodeGuru Profiler service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as creating, describing, and deleting profiling groups, as well as managing notifications and permissions.

classes.name: CodeGuruProfilerClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon CodeGuru Profiler service, extending AwsClient to provide API methods.

methods.name: addNotificationChannels
methods.description: Adds notification channels to the profiling group.

methods.name: describeProfilingGroup
methods.description: Provides details about a profiling group.

methods.name: getFindingsReportAccountSummary
methods.description: Retrieves account summary of findings report.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves IAM policy for profiling group.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a profiling group.

methods.name: updateProfilingGroup
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a profiling group.
